decisions.reason: As a close-to-core line with no visible website presence after its 2019 launch, this waterproof lined safety shoe range is best dropped in favor of newer core models and development projects.
Because this electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe showed no continued website evidence beyond 2019 in a broad and innovation-led portfolio, we would discontinue it and reallocate resources.

This safety shoe series appears not to have maintained market visibility after launch, so in a broad footwear assortment it should be phased out to avoid overlap and free capacity for refreshed ranges.
